title: Hourly confirmed-swing structure break: higher swing low then close above swing high
rule_summary: Closed 1h candles. A swing high (low) at bar i is the highest high (lowest low) of bars i-3..i+3, known only at the close of bar i+3. A swing move is only valid if the distance between consecutive opposite swings is at least 2.0%. BULLISH STRUCTURE: the latest confirmed swing low is higher than the one before it. ENTRY at the close of bar t when structure is bullish, close(t) > the latest confirmed swing high, close(t-1) was not above it, close(t) > SMA(200) of closes, and no position open. EXIT at close of bar t (next open) when close(t) < the latest confirmed swing low. Hard stop at 4% below entry. After exit wait 6 bars. Signals all hourly.
mechanism: Stop orders and breakout buy orders cluster just beyond visible swing highs; once price clears one after a higher low, forced short covering and trend followers add demand and the move tends to extend. The counterparty is the participant who sold at the prior high or whose resting stops are triggered. The 2% minimum swing and the SMA filter aim for moves that comfortably exceed the 0.35% cost.
